| U.SPC-T372 | 2026-10-21 | feature | open | Cap a single jump-gate link's span (~5 ly, tunable) instead of GateNetwork.Build's unconstrained nearest-neighbour/MST join, so reaching a system farther than that from its nearest neighbours takes multiple hops (Route already plans these) through intermediate systems' gates.
